result.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: admin-embedding.js.es6 defines a `saveChanges()` action calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but embedding.hbs contains no button bound to `saveChanges` (only `addHost`). Routing wiring exists (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`), but embedding_controller.rb's `update` action only calls `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` with no persistence at all, so it is a genuine no-op endpoint. This is not currently a user-facing defect (no UI triggers it, so no present data loss), but it is a concrete, diff-grounded concern about an incomplete/no-op save
